name: Sabotage! A Science Mission
source:
Sabotage! Shortly after arriving at a remote science outpost, our protagonist (you!) discovers a sinister plot to destroy the species living on the planet below. Get to know your four crewmates and uncover the purpose of the station in this playful visual novel.

[From [url=http://globalgamejam.org/2017/games/sabotage-science-mission]Global Game Jam[/url]]

Created for Global Game Jam 2017.
translation:
sabotage！抵达偏远科研哨站后不久，主角（也就是你）发现一个邪恶计划：摧毁行星上生活的物种。认识你的四名船员，揭开这座空间站的目的，体验这部轻松有趣的视觉小说。

（来源：[url=http://globalgamejam.org/2017/games/sabotage-science-mission]Global Game Jam[/url]）
